posts.headline: Thicks just ripped off a win to push Klint's Clipboard to 5-2, but that ring is still owed receipts because 839.22 points-for is nothing to flex after 38 straight editions of this act.
posts.detail: One title, a career 5.5 average finish, and a 14-14 record don't buy immunity from the fact his scoring total still lags division foes like Championshipsovercoochie's 941.98.

posts.headline: Chauncey's talentedtenthh finally got off the schneid at 1-6, but one win doesn't erase a career 4-10 record and a league-worst 12 average finish — the diagnosis stands.
posts.detail: 714.02 points-for through seven weeks is still bottom-of-the-barrel production from a franchise whose name has been ironic since day one.

posts.headline: One Nut Barner's fraud trial somehow gets worse — Put it in Ra drops to 2-5 and that 20-8 career record with the league's best 1.5 average finish is now a punchline wearing a crown.
posts.detail: 806.56 points-for means the talent is still there on paper, but reality keeps handing down guilty verdicts week after week.

posts.headline: Sasinci claws to 3-4 but Big Head's title defense is still on a ventilator, propped up by a career 5.5 average finish that was supposed to mean more than this.
posts.detail: 814.86 points-for and a losing stretch say the Milk Man's ring from two seasons back is becoming ancient history fast.

posts.headline: Championshipsovercoochie sits pretty at 6-1 with a league-leading 941.98 points, and mjwithgoldhoops is making the African Bald Fraud bit look like slander with no evidence.
posts.detail: A career 15-13 record and consistent 4th-place finishes never promised this kind of start — the fraud case is getting dismissed in real time.
